about_the_game:
Woke Day is a politically incorrect post-apocalyptic horror-comedy where the zombies aren’t just dead... They’re Woke.

The world has fallen to the Woke Plague. The culture war is over, and they won. Society collapsed into chaos, and almost everyone surrendered to their toxic agenda.

You are one of the last free survivors — immune to the plague, but hunted by it.
Your mission is simple: purge this infection, survive the nightmare, and fight to take back what’s left of humanity.

Ammo is scarce, resources are few, and every encounter can mean death.
You’ll need to know when to stand your ground, when to run, and when to vanish into the shadows. Because in Woke Day, the enemy doesn’t stop, doesn’t think, and doesn’t forgive.

Features:

  • A politically incorrect post-apocalyptic setting

  • Survivor shooter gameplay with scarce resources

  • Enemies as relentless as zombies — but louder

  • Creepy and absurd dark comedy horror atmosphere

  • Choices: fight, run, or die trying

  • Every shot counts. Every mistake costs.

In Woke Day, you’re not just fighting for your life.
You’re fighting for the right to stay human.
